blocks.label: Overview
bullets: 2,000 mg/Serving Omega-3 with 1,000 mg DHA Per 2 Softgels
paragraphs: Bluebonnet's Omega-3 Fish Oil Brain Health Softgels are formulated with a specific ratio of DHA and EPA to help support brain function, mood, and focus by utilizing ultra-refined omega-3s from wild-caught fish.
Every batch is tested for environmental toxins, including heavy metals. All fish oils are in the triglyceride form and surpass the strictest international standards for purity and freshness.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: As a dietary supplement, take two softgels once daily, preferably with a meal or as directed by a healthcare practitioner.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Gelatin (fish), glycerin, purified water, lemon oil, mixed tocopherols (preservative).
Free of milk, egg, crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans and sesame.
Also free of corn, gluten, barley, rice, sodium and sugar.
Made in USA from imported ingredients
This product does not contain common GE genes or proteins.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: For adults only. Consult physician if pregnant/nursing, taking mediation, or have a medical condition. Do not use this supplement two weeks before, after surgery, or with blood-thinning medication.
Keep out of reach of children.
Store tightly closed in a cool, dry place.
